description: This file defines data structures and function prototypes for managing pseudo-merge groups, commit indexes, and bitmaps related to pseudo-merges in a Git repository. It includes structures for grouping commits, loading configurations, and applying pseudo-merges, as well as functions for memory management and bitmap operations.
external_methods: apply_pseudo_merges_for_commit(const struct pseudo_merge_map *pm, struct bitmap *result, struct commit *commit, uint32_t commit_pos)
cascade_pseudo_merges(const struct pseudo_merge_map *pm, struct bitmap *result, struct bitmap *roots)

classes.name: pseudo_merge_group
classes.description: Represents a group of pseudo-merges based on a pattern and parameters, used to segment commits into pseudo-merge sets.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_matches
classes.description: Holds stable and unstable commit arrays for a pseudo-merge match set.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_map
classes.description: Serialized view of a file containing pseudo-merge data, including an array of pseudo-merges and memory-mapped file pointers.

classes.name: pseudo_merge
classes.description: Represents an individual pseudo-merge with lazy-loaded commit and bitmap data, and file location info.

methods.name: pseudo_merge_group_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a pseudo_merge_group.
